name: long_mixed_email
input:
Hello Alex,

We received your request and updated its status. You can review the details at https://support.example.com/requests/2468?from=email&campaign=update. The troubleshooting article is at www.example.com/hc/articles/12345, and current service status is available at https://status.example.com/incidents/abc123.

If you have more information to add, reply to this message or contact support@example.com. Please do not send passwords or payment details by email. For account security information, visit https://example.com/security (the page includes a checklist). You can also review the privacy policy at https://example.com/legal/privacy.

Regards,
Support Team
